hypothesis: Question: is the forward-transfer error of the HGB reference dominated by the aggregate rental LEVEL (growth between periods) rather than by the within-day/weather shape? Evidence that changed my view: idea-325a52 (valid, dev loss 59.976, base branch selected) reported forward fold 1 RMSE 116.6 for base HGB (train through day 424, holdout Mar-Apr 2012) versus 59.98 on development, and a 2012-vs-2011 daily-total ratio of 2.14 overall (Jan 2.51, Feb 2.03, Mar 2.55, Apr 1.78). Lag COUNTS as extra covariates (lag_point/lag_smooth) did not help because a tree cannot learn a lag relation for rows lacking lag support and cannot extrapolate level beyond seen yr/elapsed_day values. idea-ae78bf showed log1p/poisson losses did not beat squared error, so this program keeps squared-error HGB with baseline hyperparameters and instead changes the REPRESENTATION: target z = cnt / S(date), where S is a centered +/-14-day smoothed mean hourly count from training labels only; HGB fits z on features without yr/elapsed_day; the evaluation-date level is extrapolated as S(date-364)*r with r the geometric-mean YoY ratio of smoothed levels over the trailing 56 training days (clipped to [0.5,4] and reported), falling back to the last training level (persistence) when no analog exists, with the persistence fraction reported. Branches: base (reference HGB), yoy_scaled, blend (0.5/0.5). Contrasting expected outcomes: (A) if level shift is the main transferable error, yoy_scaled beats base clearly on fold 1 (where base was 116.6) and on development, and blend or yoy_scaled is selected with dev RMSE below 59.98; (B) if 2012 growth decelerates (April ratio 1.78 vs ~2.1 earlier) the trailing ratio over-scales, yoy_scaled is worse than base and base is re-selected, giving an informative negative result (dev loss expected to reproduce ~59.98). Pre-stated selection rule: branch with lowest mean forward RMSE over the training folds where the analog level had >=50% coverage (fold 2 has no 364-day analog in training, as 325a52 noted, so it is excluded from selection when unsupported); selection over all folds is also reported. Confirmation caveat: after refit on train+dev the level for Jul-Dec 2012 will be Jul-Dec 2011 levels times a May-Jun 2012 ratio, so any further deceleration of growth would hurt; equal-date MAE of the selected branch is reported per fold to watch the milestone constraint. Transductive use of evaluation covariates: only elapsed_day of evaluation rows is used to look up analog training levels; no evaluation labels exist in any lookup.
